## What we need & what we did this week
---
|
---
| |
### Volunteers
---
| | Working for a campaign is challenging. Even more so when you are donating your time.
We need to fill some specialty roles as well as have volunteers to accompany us for events, town halls, and canvassers to phone bank and door knock. This is an **ALL HANDS ON DECK** request!
Send an email to [Maria](mailto:volunteer@jonnyutah4congress.com?subject=Interested%20in%20volunteering%20for%20Jonny%20Larsen&body=Full%20name%2C%20phone%2C%20county%20and%20city%20you%20live%20in.%0A%0APlease%20share%20where%20you%20think%20you%20could%20best%20help%20volunteer%20for%20our%20campaign.%20No%20prior%20experience%20is%20needed%20but%20if%20you%20have%20it%2C%20please%20share!), our volunteer coordinator, to find out more.
---
|
---
| |
### Senator Cory Booker
---
| | Senator Cory Booker was in town and met with many Utah Democrats in Salt Lake and in Park City. I was fortunate enough to meet with him and share why we are a competitive district that would benefit from national party help!
Senator Booker shared inspiring stories that touched everyone who attended. What really stood out to me was his message of hope being a muscle. [Check out what he said by clicking here](https://us.list-manage.com/GgGT47yvEoF?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=Q1Eh7dk53KREIMeQsrRAMtWW0ZKdrV1esuV52DzIgQwWayUm9uijxxuOZTU7).
---

| |
### Q3 Meeting In Kane County
---
| | Huge shout out to Kane County Chair Caralee Woods for all the work that she and her amazing team put into hosting the Q3 central committee meeting in Kanab. [See a portion of my speech here](https://us.list-manage.com/TIG8p4Jtrpi?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=hiFHJqlyV6nENDM3COIqRrv5iERtHU5N-RwjcNNk34DhlQwJpcJVjbz0XguQ)
Chair Woods has been a huge supporter of ours for over a year since we first met in May of 2025 at Kane County Convention. I cannot express my gratitude enough for everything that she has done to support me and our campaign.
The food was absolutely amazing and I had a wonderful time. The drive down 89 to view the beautiful red rock is something everyone should experience at least once. If you have not been to Kanab, I highly recommend you go and visit.
---
| |
### Fire devistation continues
---
| | As of Friday, August 14th 2026, the Widemouth 2 fire has been 65% contained. On August 7th we lost two brave men who were instrumental in battling the fire in an unfortunate helicopter crash. Elliott from Porterville, CA and Andersen from Stateline, NV, we honor you for your bravery and dedication to safety of our community. You will not be forgotten, till Valhalla we met brothers. Semper Fi.
Fillmore and the surrounding areas are at high risk for burn scar flooding. As soon as I hear of the next sandbag filling event, I will let everyone know. Let’s show up as a community and help out our neighbors in a time of great need.
---
| |
### Fliers, Door Hangers, and Yard Signs
---
| | We have new fliers, new door hangers, and new yard signs! I had a unique request from a supporter and decided to print a few signs that welcome anyone who might be feeling politically homeless. We have “Republicans For” and “Independents For” yard signs in limited quantities. If you know anyone who is interested in one, invite them to one of our events above so they can come pick one up.
You can find all the canvassing events, door knocking, training, and more at the Utah Democrats mobilize page. Will you step up with a donation to help protect voting rights?
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137262229/640176921/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI1NjJjOWE4LTNkOTgtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMGQzYTExZmEzMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=u-T3smpKfd4Zo9In93vecrpsvWwCp3KLiZ7faHQpo3I=&emci=d6966183-0798-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=2562c9a8-3d98-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=8431045)

Peter, It’s been a month since Trump gutted the Election Assistance Commission (EAC) — essentially kneecapping the agency responsible for helping states run elections. name: Roy C.
subject: What’s on my mind tonight
body:
I need you with me before tomorrow’s mid-month deadline.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1123&source=&t=1&akid=2711%2E124072%2E1SiSrq)

---
Peter,
Our mid-month fundraising deadline is tomorrow, so before then, I wanted to personally reach out and share what’s going through my mind.
Republicans are ramping up their attacks against me – personal insults, character smears, baseless TV ads, you name it – and dark-money super PACs are pouring nearly $100 million into this race so far to defeat me.
**They’re spending so much in North Carolina because they know this race could decide U.S. Senate control. However, that’s not the only reason why.**
They know that if I’m elected to the U.S. Senate, I won’t blindly do President Trump’s bidding.
Instead, I’ll hold this Administration accountable when it hurts people, put working families first and do everything I possibly can to make life better for folks in North Carolina and across the country.
**I’m a threat to the GOP’s hold on power, but the only way I can fight back against their attacks is by reaching every fundraising goal from here on out. This race will come down to resources, and donations of $5 or even just a couple bucks matter more than you know.**

Will you chip in what you can to help us meet our $1 million goal, flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1123&amount=5&t=8&akid=2711%2E124072%2E1SiSrq)

clean_body: Peter, I'm retiring from Congress, and I honestly expected more. I'm not angry, I'm just disappointed. A few days ago, I sent out the signal calling on every conservative patriot in the nation to help me secure my legacy and rescue this seat from the Democrat vultures. But nothing happened. No cavalry came. As I prepare to step down, it felt like I was left to fight the entire Democratic Party by myself. For a moment, I actually feared for the future of the MAGA movement. But then I remembered, YOU never let us down, Peter. You are the reason for our historic victories, and I know you would never turn your back on this movement, especially now that I am passing the torch to the next generation. I've served as President Trump's Secretary of the Interior and as a SEAL Team 6 Commander. I've given everything to this fight, but now I need to know you'll protect the flame I'm leaving behind. My friend and fellow combat veteran, Aaron Flint, is the only one who can stop the radical left from destroying our agenda once I'm gone. But the truth is, Aaron is hours away from a critical fundraising goal that will determine the fate of this campaign. Democrats have spent millions to destroy me, and they are ready to spend millions more to slander Aaron and flip this seat Blue the moment I walk out the door. you for your support, Peter. name: Mike Rogers
subject: Never did I believe I’d see this in America
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROGERS FOR SENATE
body:
The Cold War is being fought on U.S. soil. Read my personal message.

| |
---
● Personal Message
---
Friend,
---
During my time in **national security** , I learned how to recognize a grave threat to our nation.
---

Fatal Crashes Tied to Foreign-Born Truckers

[INSIDE JW]

JUDICIAL WATCH SUES FBI FOR FAUCI CELL PHONE RECORDS

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38491&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9WcmlMR1BNMl9JST91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=a4f1793825b3fdb059464305758b45f29076f7974f091331ee161b6159ee15b2]

The American people should not have to guess about what happened
during the Covid pandemic. They deserve access to the government
records that may help explain how critical decisions were made and how
federal officials exercised their authority.

We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38456&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWZhdWNpLWNlbGwtcGhvbmVzLWNvbXBsYWludC0wMjgxMi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=87d7a6413d27d9f3312115dde0385a88c2779e453d2b25c8a053714db07da709]
against the U.S. Department of Justice for the contents of Anthony
Fauci’s government-issued cell phones. The phones were provided to
former National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
Director Fauci and later reportedly recovered by the FBI (_Judicial
Watch v. U.S. Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38456&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWZhdWNpLWNlbGwtcGhvbmVzLWNvbXBsYWludC0wMjgxMi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=87d7a6413d27d9f3312115dde0385a88c2779e453d2b25c8a053714db07da709]
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38492&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWZhdWNpLWNlbGwtcGhvbmVzLWNvbXBsYWludC0wMjgxMi9dKE5vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=41bc927e61be6274f05e2e9c8d2bbda5bb6e730d685ddc3ed976c1aa341e7103.
1:26-cv-02812)).

We sued after the FBI failed to comply with a June 2025 FOIA request
for:

> All contents obtained from the government-issued cell phones of
> former director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious
> Diseases Anthony Fauci, which were reportedly recovered by the FBI,
> as disclosed to podcaster Joe Rogan by FBI Director Kash Patel in
> the following interview:
> https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38461&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9LeWxlU2VyYXBoaW4vc3RhdHVzLzE5MzEwNTYwMTAzMTMzMjI2OTM/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=de8644dd3d84576b460db8d21233ff73ec5751cc93983484c3ab9fce7ad1ec53

The FBI claimed in October 2025 that the requested records were
located in an investigative file exempt
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=30534&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2ZvaWEtZXhlbXB0aW9ucy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=cc5349e68919db194db68f19a3cfcd91f63649b35fdfaf9d6358cbbcbcc6b458] from
disclosure under FOIA law enforcement exemption 5 U.S.C. §
552(b)(7)(A).

Patel publicly disclosed that the FBI had recovered phones and other
devices that Fauci used during the first Trump administration.

“We just had a great breakthrough this week on Fauci,” Patel told
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38462&F=T&&hash=fbbaf70d124bdd9baef44498eb7ff0eca265b285f506cebf6a8dabca101f0bf8]
Joe Rogan during a June 2025 episode of “The Joe Rogan
Experience.” Patel said investigators had been looking for phones
and devices Fauci used during the first Trump administration and that
“nobody had found it until two days ago.”

Patel cautioned that the devices might not contain everything
investigators were seeking, saying, “Maybe it’s deleted, maybe
it’s not,” but added that the FBI had found the devices and that
the search was “of public importance.”

The FBI’s refusal to release the records comes as congressional
scrutiny of Fauci and the federal government’s handling of the
Covid-19 pandemic intensifies.

On July 29, 2026, Fauci appeared before the Senate Homeland Security
and Governmental Affairs Committee under subpoena. During the hearing,
chaired by Sen. Rand Paul (R-KY), Fauci invoked
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38464&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9ueXBvc3QuY29tLzIwMjYvMDcvMjkvdXMtbmV3cy9hbnRob255LWZhdWNpLXBsZWFkcy10aGUtZmlmdGgtYW1lbmRtZW50LWluLXNlbmF0ZS1oZWFyaW5nLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=957576c32713477174d8417abb623c006f0dd429df6fbfd81a2a12414a1c145a]
the Fifth Amendment 111 times.

On August 6, 2026, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
(HHS) transferred
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38466&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud3NqLmNvbS9wb2xpdGljcy9wb2xpY3kvYW50aG9ueS1mYXVjaS1jb3ZpZC1waG9uZS1zZW5hdGUtOTZlYmQ4YmU/c3Q9dGNRU2FZJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=00bfd45707fac884a7a014f75773328a094e66f337030916497d981a49326084]
a copy of Fauci’s government-issued iPhone to the Senate Homeland
Security Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations, which is chaired by
Sen. Ron Johnson (R-WI).

Also on August 6, the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental
Affairs Committee voted 8-5 to hold Fauci in contempt
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38467&F=T&&hash=b7cd15923c76c9045619fbe6b41105b19145a0948f4186ab94aa8e5f3b655992]
of Congress over his refusal to answer questions about his handling of
the Covid-19 pandemic and his past testimony to Congress regarding
U.S.-funded “gain-of-function” research. The resolution
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38469&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucGF1bC5zZW5hdGUuZ292L3dwLWNvbnRlbnQvdXBsb2Fkcy8yMDI2LzA4L1JPTTI2Mzc2LTEucGRmP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=b35a2a6e1c3e87f78ba2f23639b2b86f95ad678212aadca6e0f53c1a95d44fa4]
directs Vice President JD Vance, in his capacity as president of the
Senate, to certify the contempt report to U.S. Attorney for the
District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro for potential prosecution.

Americans have a right to know what the FBI recovered from Fauci’s
government-issued phones and what those records reveal about his
official activities during the Covid pandemic.

Our FOIA lawsuits and investigations have uncovered much of what the
public knows about many Covid-19 controversies:

In May 2026, we filed a post-hearing brief
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=37876&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbmloLXJveWFsdHktcGF5bWVudC1yZWNvcmRzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=484cb5c01329236e8bd574f1cfca1fa1b5a5c7b0862fb432b2b3b8b7c725b002]
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38471&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbmloLXJveWFsdHktcGF5bWVudC1yZWNvcmRzL11pbj91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=e6417b651df4a29e49e77e8d1f4d6ca5d037ba88e26d876ef7a56bccad0153f3 a FOIA
lawsuit on behalf of Open the Books, urging a federal court to compel
the National Institutes of Health (NIH) to release unredacted records
showing royalty-related payments to government scientists, including

In April 2026, we sued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=37612&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVjb3Jkcy1vbi1jb3ZpZC0xOS1vcmlnaW5zLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=5be05da21b6cda2d61d121bef89dbed283d4b112b709735b6edcd3917f2b75cf] the
Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) for records and
communications of its employees with other government officials
regarding coronaviruses, the Wuhan Institute of Virology (WIV), and
related Covid-19 research.

In March 2026, we sued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=37267&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZ2Fpbi1vZi1mdW5jdGlvbi1yZWNvcmRzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=07852a06db75fab2697d4d57edea19f12964d6721df6440747967bb2e80da9e7] the U.S.
Department of Defense (War Department) for records on funding
proposals submitted to the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency
(DARPA) Biological Technologies Office prior to the Covid-19 outbreak.
The Biological Technologies Office was launched
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=37257&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZGFycGEubWlsL25ld3MvMjAxNC9iaW9sb2dpY2FsLXRlY2hub2xvZ2llcy1vZmZpY2UtbGF1bmNoP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=9806da4e8a85a1c3565518437d1f2c07d847d84c5175fea05408b80a0b7cb47b]
in 2014.

In June 2025, we sued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=35471&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY292aWQtMTktd3VoYW4tZ2FtZXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=ca17cbc23d8da4ebd6aba5e254e04af5e1b4522fc4e05a560170f7ee43ae918e] the Defense

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=35428&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9kb3dubG9hZC5taWxpdGFyeW9uZXNvdXJjZS5taWwvMTIwMzgvTU9TL1JlcG9ydHMvMjAxOS1Xb3JsZE1pbGl0YXJ5R2FtZXMtUmVwb3J0RGVjMjAyMi5wZGY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=cb95a76fe4acb54c147a1d77e461723c7bb4fbdbac41e410e6f8086c2c1ad1ae]

attended the games exhibited Covid-19-like signs and/or symptoms”
during the time surrounding their attendance at the games.

In May 2025, we received records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=35153&F=T&&hash=77f3aa68fde20d051caad65cd10bb1f197b46b282688222288d3ccdeeb40e8ab]
from the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) that
revealed its plans to mandate Covid-19 vaccinations for 17 million
health care employees and that only one of 4,682 claims for injuries
and deaths due to Covid-19 “countermeasures” at the time was
compensated.

Records uncovered in 2024 from the Federal Bureau of Investigation
(FBI) through a FOIA request showed an April 2020 email exchange with
several officials in the bureau’s Newark Field Office referring to a
National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) grant to

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84782&L=38494&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZm9yZWlnbmVycy1jb21tZXJjaWFsLWRyaXZlcnMtbGljZW5zZXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=d921220567666291a1fd7232e3fabc537ea9a0db91d3ad9b3cc5adb9520ae918]

> Foreign nationals unlawfully issued a Commercial Driver’s License
> (CDL) in states run by open border officials killed more than 30
> Americans in 17 fatal crashes last year alone, a disturbing new
> investigation reveals. Among the victims of the senseless highway
> carnage is a 5-year-old girl in California, who was critically
> injured and left with lifelong disabilities after an illegal
> immigrant crashed an 18-wheeler into her family’s vehicle. The
> Golden State leads the pack of offenders, issuing over 128,000
> non-domiciled CDLs between 2022 and 2025 and allowing applicants to
> be tested in Arabic, Chinese, Punjabi, Russian and Spanish with pass
> rates as low as 22% for Arabic speakers and 26% for Punjabi speakers
> compared with 63% for English.
>
> Leftist politicians and bureaucrats in states like California have
> systematically undermined federal CDL standards, a critical public
> safety tool, to license foreign nationals who frequently lack
> English proficiency and valid immigration status to operate
> 80,000-pound big rigs on highways throughout the U.S. The
> consequences have been deadly, according to a probe conducted by the
> Federation for American Immigration Reform (FAIR), a Washington D.C.
> nonprofit dedicated to studying immigration issues. The group used
> targeted research, public records requests and litigation as well as
> analysis of state Department of Motor Vehicle (DMV) data to conduct

name: Forward Party
subject: In it for the Long Haul
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Forward Party and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
We continue to build.

| | | [ ](www.forwardparty.com)
---
### Peter —
The Forward Party has been building the infrastructure that serious political change requires. This week, Forward's drivers are proving every step is one we take together for the growth of the movement. More than anything, this is an opportunity to leave a lasting legacy, not through any single campaign or election but by helping build one of the most consequential pieces of civic infrastructure for American politics in a generation.
###
### **This W****ee****k in Texas**
**Mike Collier fought for the movement’s future** On Monday, U.S. District Judge Robert Pitman denied Mike Collier's request for a temporary injunction that would have placed him on the Texas ballot as an independent candidate for Lieutenant Governor. Judge Pitman expressed sympathy for Collier's situation, noting that the burden the law creates is not felt similarly by candidates from the Republican and Democratic parties, but he concluded that it was not clear Collier would have succeeded in getting on the ballot even if Texas had a more moderate requirement. Collier will not be on the November ballot in Texas. That is a loss for the people of Texas who will once again have fewer choices in who to place in elected leadership. This is not the end of the story, however. Not by a long measure. **We highlighted the case in Texas previously and supported Mike in the lawsuit. As a reminder, Texas law requires that an independent candidate for statewide office must collect more than 81,030 valid voter signatures. That alone would be a serious challenge for any campaign, but Texas prohibited independent candidates from signature collection until** **after the primary runoff elections, which gave them only 30 days.** Collier took on Texas's ballot access system, which, we should note, is so burdensome that no independent candidate for statewide office has ever qualified for the ballot in a Texas race with a primary runoff. Mike knew the odds were steep and that the timeline was nearly impossible. The temporary injunction was denied but the constitutional case continues with an expected decision later this year. This ruling does not end the lawsuit. It does not settle the constitutional question. It establishes a legal record and creates precedent for future challenges. Mike Collier did not fight this battle just to get on the ballot in 2026. He fought it to build the case for changes to the ballot in 2028 and beyond. **What We Are Building with Mike Collier and Hundreds of Others Like Him** For our volunteers, donors, Fast Forward readers, and beyond, we want to say directly that our work is real. Our dedication to this country’s democracy is why we have put in the effort all these years. It is why we continue to stand behind the people who see the path to change, and we welcome more every day to join us in building something better. When people talk about a political movement, they usually mean the candidates, the yard signs, the rallies. Those things matter. But the part of a political movement that determines whether it lasts is the part nobody talks about: **the infrastructure that operates underneath it all.** | **Forward has grown state-level teams, now expanding into 41 states with chapters, leaders, volunteers, and the legal standing to participate in the political process as recognized entities**.
---
**We are reaching communities**. The Forward Party's presence in New Mexico, for example, has earned minor party status and is fielding candidates for Magistrate Judge, Public Education Commissioner, State Auditor, and U.S. Senate. New Mexico Forward Party even prevailed on a ballot access dispute before a single court hearing recently. The fact that the filing prompted a county clerk to reverse a disqualification decision illustrates something important about the long game Forward is playing. We are not going away. This is a local story but one that shows the movement is real. Parties that are serious about governing show up in county courthouses and school board races, not just Senate campaigns – and the Forward Party is doing both.
**Real change has never happened fast. It has always happened because people did not stop their pursuit of change.**
---
---

clean_body: We continue to build. | | | www.forwardparty.com Peter — The Forward Party has been building the infrastructure that serious political change requires. This week, Forward's drivers are proving every step is one we take together for the growth of the movement. More than anything, this is an opportunity to leave a lasting legacy, not through any single campaign or election but by helping build one of the most consequential pieces of civic infrastructure for American politics in a generation. This Week in Texas Mike Collier fought for the movement’s future On Monday, U.S. District Judge Robert Pitman denied Mike Collier's request for a temporary injunction that would have placed him on the Texas ballot as an independent candidate for Lieutenant Governor. Judge Pitman expressed sympathy for Collier's situation, noting that the burden the law creates is not felt similarly by candidates from the Republican and Democratic parties, but he concluded that it was not clear Collier would have succeeded in getting on the ballot even if Texas had a more moderate requirement. Collier will not be on the November ballot in Texas. That is a loss for the people of Texas who will once again have fewer choices in who to place in elected leadership. This is not the end of the story, however. Not by a long measure. We highlighted the case in Texas previously and supported Mike in the lawsuit. As a reminder, Texas law requires that an independent candidate for statewide office must collect more than 81,030 valid voter signatures. That alone would be a serious challenge for any campaign, but Texas prohibited independent candidates from signature collection until after the primary runoff elections, which gave them only 30 days. Collier took on Texas's ballot access system, which, we should note, is so burdensome that no independent candidate for statewide office has ever qualified for the ballot in a Texas race with a primary runoff. Mike knew the odds were steep and that the timeline was nearly impossible. The temporary injunction was denied but the constitutional case continues with an expected decision later this year. This ruling does not end the lawsuit. It does not settle the constitutional question. It establishes a legal record and creates precedent for future challenges. Mike Collier did not fight this battle just to get on the ballot in 2026. He fought it to build the case for changes to the ballot in 2028 and beyond. Our dedication to this country’s democracy is why we have put in the effort all these years. name: Ken Martin (via DNC HQ)
subject: This was a risky move
body:
---
Derek, I want to tell you about a pretty risky decision that I made last year: For too long, Democratic strategy has been dominated by a boom-and-bust political model. We raise money, build temporary campaign operations late in the cycle, hire short-term organizers, run last-minute advertisements, hold an election, and then dismantle much of the infrastructure we just created. Skilled staff scatter. Field offices close. Local relationships atrophy. Voters may not hear from the party again until the next election, when we return to ask for their votes. Then, every two or four years, we spend enormous sums rebuilding what we allowed to disappear. **When I ran for DNC chair, I knew I wanted to try something different:** Replacing this decades-old campaign model with permanent political infrastructure. We are not choosing between winning now and building for the future. The investments we’re making are designed to do both: Win big this November **_and**_ build a stronger party for the elections that follow. And here’s the thing: **_This new strategy is working.**_ We know that because Democrats have won or overperformed in nearly 90% of key races since Donald Trump took office. Derek, 90% isn’t an accident, it’s hard work paying off. But we can’t take our success in the last year and a half as permission to rest for one single second before November. **I took this calculated risk knowing that we could count on _you_ , our grassroots supporters, to back us.** Which is why I’m writing today to ask: [**Will you chip in $7 to the DNC today? We promise we won’t let your contribution sit in a bank account for months on end, we’ll put it to work right away to power Democrats to victory up and down the ballot, across the country — and build permanent infrastructure to keep that momentum growing far beyond this November.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260814_8614_fr&amount=7&refcode2=8614_22930333_E2W8fv&akid=8614%2E22930333%2EE2W8fv) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-2026-gfr?express_lane=true&amount=7&refcode=em_20260814_8614_fr&refcode2=8614_22930333_E2W8fv&akid=8614%2E22930333%2EE2W8fv)**

body:
Texas is officially in play for Democrats this year!

| | | [ ](https://www.tanyafortexas.com/r?u=uGD1_JWQzocUoO6G1sZMF-tYIAuKQ97Z_lDiPedGAn11JJNENg30eeUPXVkqayxCfDLIkkjdPcC_U3XuHRoCIwMELeQenzQ2oHmoOYJU340&e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=week_5_08_14&n=1)
---
Is your household affected by back to school, too? Our small (but mighty!) mostly volunteer team has been working alongside the statewide and county Democratic coordinated campaigns, adding a merch store to our website (launching soon!), setting up Meet & Greets (reply to this email to host one!) and fleshing out GOTV (“Get out the vote”) plans. There are soooo many meetings. But there is also so much encouraging news. Texas is officially in play for Democrats this year! Talarico is surging ahead in the polls against fraudulent, bribery-making, and cheating Ken Paxton.**_
_** And guess what? **We’re going to be listed right under his name on the ballot.** **And thanks to Republicans hubris, this monstrously gerrymandered 27th district is more like a swingable +6 than a +15.** So when Democrats go to the polls this year, they are going to have back-to-back hard working teachers to vote for. But it goes beyond Democrats. We’re growing the coalition here in TX-27 to include: 🚢 Veterans who are watching sailors deployed in the Middle East jump overboard because _the conditions on the ships are so horrific._ 🏥 Parents who lost health insurance and are now desperately _praying their kids don’t get sick._ 💰 Small business owners who might have to close and let go of their employees because _life has gotten so d*mn expensive for everyone._ The money you invest in this race helps Democratic candidates up and down the entire ballot, from Talarico to our local council member.
---
**_This Upcoming Week at a Glance_** _Sunday, August 16th_ | Sign up for upcoming events like our [South Austin Meet & Greet](https://www.tanyafortx27.com/meet_greet_shady_hollow?e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=week_5_08_14&n=2). Not in Austin, but have friends or family in Austin? Please share! **_Some of Last Week’s Highlights_**

And we need resources to push us past the finish line. If you have ever thought about donating, the time is NOW.** Let’s make history together to flip Texas.

[Click here](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-e-fjijjg-didthutlhu-c/) [](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fjijjg-didthutlhu-r/) Patriot,Earlier this week, Democrats nominated Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley for governor after a chaotic primary that saw him drop out, re-enter, and narrowly edge out radical Francesca Hong. Crowley now faces Congressman Tom Tiffany this November. Tiffany is a lifelong Wisconsinite, dairy farm kid, and small business owner who has fought for lower taxes, stronger public safety, and real accountability. He's ready to end Evers' 400-year property tax hike, freeze property taxes, and put working families first.Crowley's record in Milwaukee County tells a different story: repeated budget shortfalls, higher property taxes, and the state's largest sales tax increase while deficits persist. Wisconsin can't afford to export that approach statewide. The choice is clear: support Tom Tiffany for Governor. Donate, volunteer, and share this message so we can defeat Crowley and deliver the conservative leadership Wisconsin needs.-Team WisGOP **In the News** [](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fjijjg-didthutlhu-y/) [](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fjijjg-didthutlhu-j/) **Take Action!** **Help us Bring Victories to Republican candidates!**
Campaigns take money, and we need YOUR help to fund campaigns at every level. With your aid, we're ahead thus far, but Democratic out-of-state billionaires are ready to retaliate at the slightest hint of lost momentum. Keep Wisconsin politics in Wisconsinite hands and donate TODAY! [DONATE TODAY!](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fjijjg-didthutlhu-t/) **Volunteer for the Republican Party!**
Looking to step up your involvement? The Republican Party of Wisconsin in your local county needs volunteers to support campaigns and election processes, manage events, and initiate outreach. Volunteering allows YOU to make a tangible impact where it matters most: in your own neighborhood. Sign up below! [SIGN UP TODAY!](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fjijjg-didthutlhu-h/) **Meet Republicans in Your County!**
Your county Republican party is dedicated to making YOUR VOICE HEARD in your community. Events range from Pints n' Politics nights to representing Republicans at high-profile events -- you choose how you want to be involved. Take advantage by checking out the full schedule of county events below! [FIND EVENTS NEAR YOU!](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fjijjg-didthutlhu-k/)
